# ScaleHaven

> ScaleHaven is a done-for-you marketing agency for med spas, aesthetic clinics, and plastic surgery practices in the US & Canada. We run Meta Ads, Google Ads, and SEO that deliver financially qualified patients (with optional follow-up automation) — and guarantee 15+ booked consultations in a client's first month, or we work free until they hit it. Founded by an operator who grew a cosmetic clinic into one of the largest in its region before it sold to a private equity firm.

## Services (money pages)

- [Med Spa Advertising](https://scalehaven.io/med-spa-advertising/): Meta + Google paid advertising management for med spas
- [Med Spa Facebook Ads](https://scalehaven.io/med-spa-facebook-ads/): Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ads management
- [Med Spa Google Ads](https://scalehaven.io/med-spa-google-ads/): Google Ads & PPC management
- [Med Spa SEO](https://scalehaven.io/med-spa-seo/): SEO and local search services for medical spas
- [Med Spa Web Design](https://scalehaven.io/med-spa-web-design/): SEO-first websites built to rank and convert
- [Med Spa Lead Generation](https://scalehaven.io/med-spa-lead-generation/): Guaranteed patient lead generation
- [Aesthetic Clinic Marketing](https://scalehaven.io/aesthetic-clinic-marketing/): Marketing for aesthetic clinics
- [Plastic Surgery Marketing](https://scalehaven.io/plastic-surgery-marketing/): Marketing for plastic & cosmetic surgery practices
- [Dermatology Marketing](https://scalehaven.io/dermatology-marketing/): Marketing for dermatology practices
- [Botox Clinic Marketing](https://scalehaven.io/botox-clinic-marketing/): Marketing for Botox & injectable clinics
